notes:
Overview:
- CallCompass InsightWorks: omnichannel contact center vendor + managed services for enterprise telcos. ~2,500 agents (NA/EU), heavy inbound voice volume with daily spikes (marketing/promotions).
- Interested in automating post-call summaries (short TL;DR + coaching highlights + QA scorecards) + ticket creation into Zendesk/SFDC via tool-calling.

Business needs / requirements (customer language):
- "We need reliable summaries within ~30s of call wrap so supervisors can triage faster." — Head of CX
- Latency: summary generation pipeline target <= 45s end-to-end during 90th percentile spikes; baseline < 20s off-peak.
- Throughput: avg 10k calls/day, peak concurrency ~800 active post-call jobs per minute during promotional peaks.
- Accuracy/quality: QA rubric for highlights (agent empathy, compliance checks, issue resolution) — want configurable templates for coaching.
- Integration: Zendesk ticket creation, SFDC case update, and webhook exports to internal MDM.
- Security: EU data residency for EU tenants, full audit logs, SSO (SAML), KMS-managed encryption, PII redaction (PCI/PII scrubbing).

POC status & technical notes:
- 2026-02-10: Discovery call (Jordan + Ravi) — established use cases, metrics.
- 2026-02-17: POC kickoff (subset of 500 calls/day routed to Redwood Dedicated test pool).
- 2026-02-25: Security questionnaire submitted (see drive link).
- 2026-03-01: POC run: first 500 calls processed, basic summaries generated; early metrics: median latency 18s, 95th pct 62s (issue on batching during bursts).
- 2026-03-05: Integration test w/ Zendesk webhook (ticket created, attachments sanitized).
- 2026-03-08: Product demo to ops + QA team; ops asked for fallback model routing when Dedicated is saturated.

Open technical observations from POC:
- KV/prefix caching helped for canned prompts but spikes still cause >50s tail on some runs; suggested kernel-level tuning + more aggressive batching policies.
- Customer requests deterministic QA templates (scoring + highlights) and config UI for which highlights to surface.
- Wants function/tool-calling to populate Zendesk fields and auto-tag with coaching flags.

Security/legal notes:
- Legal: needs contractual clause for EU residency; CISO asked for encryption-at-rest proof and HSM/KMS flow.
- Compliance: require SOC2 Type II evidence + ISO27001 attestation.

Next steps (short):
- Schedule infra/security deep-dive w/ CISO and infra (Jordan + Ravi) — aim week of 2026-03-15.
- Deliver Dedicated sizing + pricing by 2026-03-12.
- Agree on POC acceptance criteria: 95th pct latency < 50s, QA match rate > 85% on coaching flags, successful Zendesk ticketing w/o PII leakage.

Stubs/links & refs:
- Fireflies: ff_20260215_7a3d9b (discovery), ff_20260301_0192bc (POC sync).
- Gmail threads: thread:1729a9c3d0e (pricing convo), thread:173f2b5ec12 (legal exchange).
- Drive: drive://redwood-deck/prod-pricing-callcompass.pdf, drive://security/CallCompass-Sec-FAQ-2026-02-25.pdf.
- Jira: JIRA-CC-4127 (POC incident: batching misconfig), JIRA-SEC-78 (security questionnaire follow-up).

Sales notes (AE shorthand):
- Champion: Dir. of QA (Eva Marquez) — cares about coaching insights and rolling audits.
- Economic buyer: VP Ops (Tom Greene) — concerned about unit economics and predictable throughput.
- Quote: "If you can give us consistent tails <50s and a clear pricing model for Dedicated during promos, we can move to procurement this quarter."

Blockers (again):
- Legal language for EU residency + data transfer; SSO cert exchange timeline; budget sign-off for Dedicated commit.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Enterprise CC vendor testing Redwood Dedicated for post-call summaries + agent assist. POC showed promise (median latency good) but tail latency on spikes needs mitigation. Security review in progress; next step is infra/security call and final Dedicated pricing.
